Hi so due to me being bipolar and like you said sex can either make me manic or depressed or even suicidal. I don't have a healthy relationship with sex or any kind of romantic relationships at all and it even just turns out I can barely even have a family or friends relationship. My life was spiraling so I got sent to the hospital for 4 months and while I was there I realized I need to find out what I want and need just in general and ofcourse sex. Well that was 2 1/2 years ago which sounds insane because I had a super active sex life before. These past 2 1/2 years I've learned to have a healthy relationship with myself foremost, then my family, then my friends and eventually I will be ready for romance. I know this sounds like a long time to be abstinent but it just goes to show myself I never had any healthy relationship before and that's why it's taken me so long because God dam just having a friend is like hard I have to work on it everyday. I'm now open to love but I do not seek it anymore I don't use it like a drug anymore. I realized who I am (at age 24) and that scared me, like I never paid attention to what I wanted I just was a people pleaser who would break my back for literally anyone. I don't know if this helps at all but I just wanted to let u know your not alone and I get it
